shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "ls -la && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- instructions ---\\n' && for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f \""'$f" ]; then echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- tracked files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' && printf '\\n--- components/request-metadata.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' components/request-metadata.tsx && printf '\\n--- all source refs ---\\n' && rg -n \"RequestMetadata|cacheComponents|unstable_cache|use cache|connection\\(|headers\\(|cookies\\(|Math\\.random|Date\\(\" . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json package-lock.json && printf '\\n--- next version ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && printf '\\n--- cache API references ---\\n' && rg -n \"connection\\(\\)|cacheComponents|Cache Components|randomUUID\" node_modules/next/dist/docs node_modules/next 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'

+const nextConfig: NextConfig = {

@@

+import { connection } from 'next/server'
 
-export function RequestMetadata() {
+export async function RequestMetadata() {
+  await connection()
+
   const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString()
*** End Patch

npm run build"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- source diff ---\\n' && git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- tsconfig baseline ---\\n' && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "nl -ba next.config.ts && printf '\\n' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n' && nl -ba components/request-metadata.tsx && printf '\\n--- prerender manifest route summary ---\\n' && node -e \"const m=require('./.next/prerender-manifest.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(m.routes, null, 2))\" | head -80"
/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- .gitignore ---'; cat .gitignore; printf '\\n--- generated tsconfig/runtime files ---\\n'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -c 'set -e; first=$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/); second=$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/); printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$first" | sed '"'s/></>\\n</g' | rg 'nav|Request |generated at|sample'; printf '\\n--- second request metadata ---\\n'; printf '%s\\n' \""'$second" | sed '"'s/></>\\n</g' | rg 'Request |generated at|sample'; first_id="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$first" | sed '"'s/></>\\n</g' | sed -n 's/.*Request \\(["'^ ]*'"\\).*/\\1/p'); second_id="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$second" | sed '"'s/></>\\n</g' | sed -n 's/.*Request \\(["'^ ]*'"\\).*/\\1/p'); test -n \""'$first_id" && test -n "$second_id" && test "$first_id" != "$second_id" && echo '"'request IDs differ'"
